name: Forescout Cybersecurity Glossary
description: Forescout Cybersecurity Glossary — 50 terms centered on agentless device visibility and control: network access control (NAC), asset inventory, OT/ICS/IoT/IoMT security, network segmentation, zero trust, and vulnerability management. Aligned to Forescout's device-intelligence and network-security product domain. Source entries are SEO-article format; per-term definitions are taken from each entry's meta-description summary.
relationToCloudSecurity: Moderate — device visibility, asset inventory, and zero-trust segmentation terms extend to cloud and hybrid environments, though the core focus is on-premises and OT/IoT device control.
relationToAISecurity: Indirect — Forescout applies analytics and ML to device classification and risk scoring; the glossary is not AI-security-specific.
